Name: Lunatic Farm Map
Author: JPopcorn
Description:
[center][b]
[color=#f1c232]Want to point out if you use old save with any map mods you maybe will encounter something out of place.
Start new save game or use the old one at your own risk.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/rYLN8rs.png[/img][/color]
[color=#f1c232][size=3]
Installation:[/size][/color][/b][color=#f1c232]
[/color]Unpack using either Winrar or 7Zip
Copy and paste the Farm.xnb inside your Stardew Valley "Maps" folder. (Location: Stardew Valley\Content\Maps)
This replaces the first Farm Map.

[/center][size=4][b]Update Log:[/b][/size]

1.0 - Release.

1.1 - Fixed the house door.

1.2 - Fixed the exit to the city (Right side) the character could ghost out of the map.
Gave some space for pets to walk near the lake.

1.3 - Added space on the side of the lake for the spouse.
        Fixed color miss matched on the bottom cliffs.

1.4 - Fixed the Greenhouse door.

1.5 - Fixed Mr Qi's challenge no club card on the Wood pile on the left side of the house.

1.6 - Reduced the size of the grass on the left side of the house.
>>>> Updated the screenshots and install Readme.
>>>> Added more versions without debris and without Telescope.

1.7 - Fixed GreenHouse door again (Bug was introduced on Version 1.6).
        Removed near top exit Fidget Spinner.
        Fixed bush glitching on top of house.
        Remade dock to look more natural and reduce width from 3 squares to 2.

2.0 - Updated to work with new multiplayer patch.
﻿Fixed wrong floor on right side of the house.
﻿Added many new block spots from the vanila game update.
﻿Moved the mailbox back to vanila spot. (Needed to work on Multiplayer patch)
﻿Packed all maps into one File to download only. (All maps inside)

This is the updated version of my map compilation mod i have done years ago, its been updated to work on the new multiplayer patch.
Hope you enjoy, cheers.
